summary.en: Tencent's Windows app store client (應用寶); Linaro lists it as native Arm64.

evidence.title: Linaro Works on WoA record: 腾讯应用宝 (Tencent App Store), native, from 5.20.17.10

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general (validated on Qualcomm hardware, last updated 2026-03-02); RTX Spark was not tested.
